field.label: Enable
field.help: Enable the Gatus service. Endpoints, alerting, storage and the web listener are configured in /usr/local/etc/gatus.yaml. Gatus listens on port 8080 on all interfaces unless the web section of that file says otherwise. This file is not part of the OPNsense configuration backup.

field.label: Run as Root
field.help: Gatus runs as the unprivileged www user by default. ICMP (ping) checks need raw sockets, which only root can open on FreeBSD, so enable this if the configuration uses icmp:// endpoints. Use with care: the whole Gatus process, including its web server, then runs as root.

field.label: Log Level
field.help: Verbosity of /var/log/gatus.log. Info logs the result of every check.
